topic: The stewardship pursuit — conservation + measurement-standards as public goods, distinct from the commercial industrial-instruments line.
purpose: Local bring-your-own-AI onboarding node. Orient any AI/agent on the stewardship track, then hand back to the central chain.
paths_note: key_files relative to THIS folder; join_the_chain relative to the Hs repo root.

byo_ai_onboarding.mission: Learn compositional analysis with Hs — a deterministic EXTENSION to standard CoDa — well enough to run it and read its outputs. Bring your own AI; this node + the chain teach it.
byo_ai_onboarding.the_one_idea: A composition carries only relative information; Hs reads its DYNAMICS in Aitchison log-ratio geometry, deterministically, with a hash receipt. 4 parts = an exact quaternion rotation; higher-D is tiled from overlapping exact 4-part charts and reconstructed losslessly.
byo_ai_onboarding.standard_coda_relation: Hs uses STANDARD CoDa tools (closure, CLR, ILR/Helmert, the Aitchison metric) and extends them into a deterministic monitoring instrument for machine and embedded applications. The mathematics is standard CoDa-compatible; the deterministic instrument is the new part.
byo_ai_onboarding.determinism_doctrine: Determinism is binding by doctrine AND practice: same input -> same output -> same content hash; no statistics in the science path. See ../../HUF/huf-gov/doctrine/.
learning_path: ramsar-wetlands/README.md (the two-tier wetland offering + honest gap)
byo_ai_onboarding.expert_decides: The instrument reads and hands you diagnostics; the domain expert (conservation scientist, standards committee) assigns meaning. Open-loop (Skydiver Doctrine). In this folder the work is offered, not sold.

specific_knowledge.what: Two stewardship pursuits, kept separate from the commercial line: (1) ISO — positioning MC-4 (Composition Monitoring) as the missing 4th monitoring category (MC-1/2/3 are standardised under ISO/TC 69; composition has no ISO home; a proposal, not a standard). (2) Ramsar — the Convention on Wetlands (1971; 172 Parties; ~2,500 sites); Hs offers governance + field-work compositional tools across 5 wetland time-series types; the honest complexity gap is named.
key_results: Tier 2: honest, deterministic, open-loop offer cleanly separated from commerce.
Tier 3 (to earn): ISO engagement on merits; a wetland scientist finding the read useful; independent reproduction. None claimed today.
specific_knowledge.claim_tiers: Tier 1 = verified/computed; Tier 2 = standard math soundly applied / practiced doctrine; Tier 3 = to earn.

governance: Honest-broker; interest expressed never acquired; all outreach DRAFT/unsent; Peter is the sole commit/contact gate; AI-assisted per HUF-STD-001. Public good — nothing sold in this folder.
